Other changes concern the Andamans and Nicobars, Assam, Bombay, Punjab and Sikkim. The 1891 Rajputana figure includes an estimate of Bhils.
method: Day-weighted linear interpolation between comparable enumeration endpoints, rounded to the nearest person. Each area is rounded independently. The census supplies no 1900 count or uncertainty interval. Famine and migration could change the timing of intercensal growth or decline.
locator: Table II-A, p. 9 explanatory notes and p. 10, persons, columns 2 (1901) and 3 (1891). Rows 1-12 comprise provinces and rows 13-24 states and agencies. Aden is already included in row 6. Control: Common enumeration area excluding Aden.
